name: Live operating system
description: The adversary might leverage live operating systems which operate only in memory and therefore leave less traces then installed operating systems on harddisks.

subtechniques.name: Diskless live VMs
subtechniques.description: Diskless liveCD VM’s are useful when isolation matters, because VM storage in RAM doesn’t survive rebooting. This reduces the amount of traces left behind.

subtechniques.name: USB live disk software
subtechniques.description: USB live disk software is preferred since it entirely operates in memory, and therefore leaves less traces.

procedures.name: Etcher
procedures.description: Balena is a powerful OS image flasher built with web technologies to ensure flashing an SD card or USB drive is a pleasant and safe experience. https://etcher.balena.io/

procedures.name: Persistent Storage
procedures.description: Encrypted persistent storage partition on a Tails or similar live OS USB drive, preserving files and configuration across sessions
